Title: Azure Resource Manager template support for Azure file share backup

Body.Content:
Azure Backup now supports configuring backup for existing Azure file shares using Azure Resource Manager (ARM) template. Azure Resource Manager is a native and powerful way to manage your infrastructure through declarative templates. Customers can now enable backup for their existing file shares by specifying the vault and backup policy details in a JSON file which can be deployed by using the Azure portal, Azure Powershell, or Azure CLI.

Learn more
